dex.entry: A magnificent ember-moth with broad, vein-lit wings that trail blazing filaments and leave a shower of sparks with every wingbeat. From clumsy little Wickmoth to this gorgeous blazing terror — one of the most satisfying glow-ups in Vesperholm.

art.silhouette: Wide, spread-wing moth silhouette; upper wings are deep charcoal laced with bright ember veins, lower wings trail glowing filaments; menacing and beautiful at 64px.
